source_note: 判断序列在区间内稠密的几个命题
english_source_note: Criteria for Density of Sequences in an Interval
callout_id: 判断序列在区间内稠密的几个命题#12
statement_en:
Let $f:[1,+\infty)\to\mathbb{R}$ be differentiable, with $f'(x)>0$ and $f'(x)$ monotonically decreasing. Assume also that
$$\lim_{x\to \infty} f'(x)=0,\quad \lim_{x\to \infty} x f'(x)=\infty.$$ 
Then the sequence $f(n)$ is uniformly distributed modulo $1$.
callout_body: 设$f:[1,+\infty)\to \mathbb{R}$可微，并且$f'(x)>0$并且$f'(x)$单调减少。此外$$\lim_{x\to \infty}f'(x)=0,\quad \lim_{x\to \infty} xf'(x)=\infty$$那么序列$f(n)$模1均匀分布。
